title: Safeguarding Neighborhoods from Flooding: The City of San Diego Prepares for Storm Season Year-round
description:
The City’s Stormwater Department teams work year-round to help protect the community from flooding during storms. Get a behind-the-scenes look at how crews maintain channels, inspect storm drains, and respond to rain-related issues.
Thank you to the dedicated employees who help keep our community prepared for storm season.
Learn more about what you can do to help prevent flooding on the City’s Storm Preparedness page: https://www.sandiego.gov/storm-preparedness
#ThinkBlue #SanDiegoAtWork
